title: Efficient LLM-Generated Shuttling Compilers for Complex Trapped-Ion Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2607.24714v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Trapped-ion quantum computers rely on shuttling compilers, which cast an input algorithm into a sequence of ion-qubit movements within a given architecture. We present the first study in which a single frontier large language model (LLM), Claude Opus 4.7, generates and iteratively refines the Python code of shuttling compilers from written specifications. Starting with a compiler for (i) a linear segmented trap, we extend it to (ii) a trap with junctions, and finally achieve efficient compilation for (iii) a broad class of connected trap graphs. The compilers for the more general cases are seeded with code from the previous ones. We benchmark the LLM-generated compilers against state-of-the-art hand-crafted ones using a common suite of quantum circuits. translated_title: 用于复杂离子阱架构的高效LLM生成的穿梭编译器
translated_abstract: 离子阱量子计算机依赖于穿梭编译器，它将输入算法转化为在给定架构内离子量子比特移动的序列。我们提出了首个这样的研究：单个前沿大语言模型（LLM）Claude Opus 4.7 根据书面规范生成并迭代改进穿梭编译器的Python代码。从针对(i)线性分段离子阱的编译器开始，我们将其扩展到(ii)带有结点的离子阱，最终实现了对(iii)一大类连通离子阱图的高效编译。针对更一般情况的编译器以之前编译器的代码作为种子。我们使用一套通用的量子电路，将LLM生成的编译器与最先进的手工编译器进行基准测试。对于(i)，穿梭时间步数最多减少了72%；对于(ii)，最多减少了43%。对于自由连接架构的广泛情形(iii)，我们发现（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次展示单个前沿大语言模型（Claude Opus 4.7）能够根据书面规范自动生成并迭代优化离子阱量子计算机的穿梭编译器，在多种离子阱架构上比最先进的手工编译器减少多达72%的穿梭时间步。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first study in which a single frontier LLM (Claude Opus 4.7) generates and iteratively refines shuttling compilers for trapped-ion quantum computers from written specifications, reducing shuttling timesteps by up to 72% compared to state-of-the-art hand-crafted compilers.
